//: Each plugin's Modrinth page lists these in "More from Xena Studios", with why, and only once they're released. Read by scripts/catalog.ts. Keep every reason true of the plugins as they are: no planned integrations.

xutilities.xteleport: Homes, TPA, warps and `/rtp` to go with xUtilities' `/back`, which takes players back from every xTeleport teleport.
xutilities.zchat: Chat formats per rank and a filter, with messages themed the same way as xUtilities' own.

zchat.xbans: Mutes that hold in chat and `/msg`, by every alias, with a history of who was muted and why.
zchat.xutilities: The everyday commands, `/fly`, `/heal` and `/back`, in the same look.

xlimbo.xbans: Install it on the limbo server too and it enforces the network's bans there, with nothing else to set up.
xlimbo.xutilities: The everyday commands for the main server, in the same look.

xrewind.xbans: Found who griefed spawn? Ban them, with templates that go from a week to a month to permanent.
xrewind.xbackup: Backups of the whole server, with xRewind's SQLite database copied safely while it's being written.

xplots.xmoney: Rent paid through Vault, with no Vault.jar installed.
xplots.xrewind: See who placed or broke what on a plot, and put it back.

xteleport.xutilities: `/back` and `/top`: `/back` takes players back from every xTeleport teleport.
xteleport.xmoney: Teleport costs through Vault, with no Vault.jar installed.

xvote.xmoney: Money rewards through Vault, with no Vault.jar installed.
xvote.xstats: Turn xVote's placeholders into daily, weekly and monthly leaderboards, and onto your stats website.

xbans.xrewind: See what a banned griefer broke or took, and roll it back.
xbans.xlimbo: A fallback server for when your main one goes down. With xBans installed there too, it enforces the same bans.

xmoney.xvote: Pays vote rewards into xMoney balances through Vault.
xmoney.xplots: Plots players rent with xMoney, through Vault.
xmoney.xteleport: Teleport costs, taken from xMoney balances through Vault.

xstats.xvote: Vote totals and streaks as placeholders, for xStats to rank by day, week and month.
xstats.xmoney: Balances as placeholders, for a money leaderboard and a page on your stats website.

xbackup.xrewind: Its SQLite database is copied by SQLite itself, so a backup never holds a half-written block log.
xbackup.xplots: Its SQLite database and every plot's saved state, backed up with the rest of the server.
